note: Improved Multi Select is a front-end enhancement driven entirely by the config object improved_multi_select.settings (route ims.settings at /admin/config/user-interface/ims, gated by 'administer site configuration'). It has no field widget of its own (that is the ims_options_widget submodule), no permissions of its own, no Drush, no plugin types. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real config keys: isall, url, selectors, filtertype (partial|exact|anywords|anywords_partial|allwords|allwords_partial), orderable, groupresetfilter, js_regex, remove_required_attr, placeholder_text, buttontext_add/addall/del/delall/moveup/movedown. Introspection reads those keys back; execution writes them and verifies against the live config. Scripts restore the shipped defaults explicitly (State is unreliable on this site).

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site I enabled the improved_multi_select module. Where do I configure it (admin path and/or route), and what single config object stores all of its settings?
evals.expected_output: Configure it at /admin/config/user-interface/ims (route ims.settings, permission 'administer site configuration'). All keys live in one config object, improved_multi_select.settings.

evals.prompt: Using improved_multi_select, which config key do I turn on so that EVERY multi-select box on the whole site becomes the two-panel widget, and what jQuery selector does it then target by default?
evals.expected_output: Set isall to TRUE (the 'Replace all multi-select lists' option). When on, the module attaches the widget to the default selector select[multiple] on every page.

evals.prompt: In improved_multi_select's settings, which config key controls how the search box matches options, and what are its possible values?
evals.expected_output: The filtertype key. Values: partial (default), exact, anywords, anywords_partial, allwords, allwords_partial. The _partial variants allow substring/partial-word matches.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site already has improved_multi_select configured. Inspect the live configuration and tell me which filter functionality (filtertype) is currently set and what the search-box placeholder text is.
evals.expected_output: In improved_multi_select.settings, filtertype is 'allwords_partial' and placeholder_text is 'ims_find_here'. Read with: drush cget improved_multi_select.settings.

evals.prompt: On this site, is improved_multi_select currently configured to replace ALL multi-select boxes site-wide, and what custom text has been set for the 'Add' button? Inspect the running configuration to answer.
evals.expected_output: Yes: improved_multi_select.settings has isall=true, and buttontext_add is 'ADDIMS'. Read via drush cget improved_multi_select.settings.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the improved_multi_select module so that its two-panel widget replaces ALL multi-select boxes site-wide, and set the search-box placeholder text to exactly 'Filter options'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In improved_multi_select.settings set isall=TRUE and placeholder_text='Filter options' (e.g. via the settings form at /admin/config/user-interface/ims or drush/configFactory).

evals.prompt: Configure improved_multi_select so that editors can re-order selected items with Move up / Move down buttons, and change the 'Add' button label to exactly 'ADD'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In improved_multi_select.settings set orderable=TRUE and buttontext_add='ADD'.
